tiers.label: Gold Star
tiers.notes: Full warehouse, Costco.com, food court, and pharmacy access. No annual reward.
tiers.source: Costco Executive 2% Reward FAQs; The Motley Fool, Jan 16, 2026

tiers.label: Executive
tiers.notes: Includes the $65 Gold Star base plus a $65 Executive upgrade. Pays 2% back on qualifying Costco, Costco.com, and Costco Travel purchases, capped at $1,250/yr. Costco refunds the upgrade fee if your 2% reward doesn't cover it.
tiers.source: Costco Executive 2% Reward FAQs; The Motley Fool, Jan 16, 2026

tiers.label: Club
tiers.notes: Standard membership, no Sam's Cash reward.
tiers.source: CNBC, Apr 1, 2026; Sam's Club official join page

tiers.label: Plus
tiers.notes: 2% Sam's Cash on qualifying in-club purchases, capped at $750/yr (raised from $500/yr on May 1, 2026). Also includes early shopping hours and free shipping on orders over $50.
tiers.source: The Krazy Coupon Lady, 2026; Sam's Club official join page

tiers.label: Club+
tiers.notes: 2% back on eligible purchases, capped at $500/yr, plus 5 cents/gallon off BJ's gas and two free same-day delivery orders per membership year.
tiers.source: BJ's Wholesale Club membership program breakdown, 2026

tiers.label: Prime
tiers.notes: No purchase-based reward. Value comes from free/fast shipping, Prime Video, and other perks — you estimate what that's worth to you.
